comments.body:
[P2] Streaming path still drops usage containing only detail fields.

captureChatStreamUsage still returns early when prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, and total_tokens are all zero. If an upstream usage chunk only provides cached_tokens or reasoning_tokens, the new conversion function is never executed, causing these values to be lost from both the streaming response and subsequent usage accounting.

Recommendation: Extend the guard condition to include detail fields, and add a streaming test containing only detail fields to verify that both the final event and usage counters preserve these values.
